additional_info.subject: Assistance Needed with Charger (JLKpZW) – Issue with Outlet 1 Charging
additional_info.body:
Good day,
We need assistance with Charger (JLKpZW). During testing of the EMS system based on a customer request, we made changes to the OCPP link. We updated it twice, first successfully, but the second attempt did not work. As a result, we decided to revert the charger settings back to the original configuration.
Currently, we are testing the charger, and Outlet 2 is charging properly without any issues. However, Outlet 1 is charging, but only at 0 amps. It appears to be limited, but we are unsure of the source of the limitation. I’ve attached a picture for your reference.
We were working under Case ID: 0405667 and Charger ID: JLKpZW.
Could you kindly assist us in identifying and resolving the issue?
Thank you for your time and support.
Met vriendelijke groet | Kind regards | Med venlig hilsen | s pozdravom

additional_info.subject: RE: Assistance Needed with Charger (JLKpZW) – Issue with Outlet 1 Charging
additional_info.body:
Hi all,
We can close this ticket. I had a look with Ingo. The charger was online in the Maxem backend for a short time, Maxem then set a default profile of 0kW. They change that when starting a transaction.
We brought it back to e-Flux, but they have a different approach and don’t change the TxProfile, so the 0kW default profile was stuck. Ingo removed it manually and the charger works fine again
😊
Thomas
